title: Design an ATM
summary: Model an ATM as a state machine where each state permits only what is safe from it, and build the note dispenser as a chain of denomination handlers that plans the full amount before a single note leaves the box.
concepts: States as a security boundary, not just a convenience
All-or-nothing dispensing: planning against a copy before committing
Ordering a debit and a dispense so a failure never costs the customer
Keeping the bank separate from the machine so it can be stubbed
Greedy note selection, and when it stops being correct
extensions: Add a transaction log that survives a power cut mid-dispense
Support multiple currencies in one machine
Add card types with different daily limits and fees
Handle a network outage to the bank with offline limits
Make the machine safe against concurrent sessions on a shared cash box
